title: Identity-point support comparisons and normalized counit data
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D$ and a family of coefficient categories $B_X$ for its finite-type spaces, with a push stage $S$ of [def-sf-operation-stages]. Write $s=\operatorname{Spec}D.k$, $a:X	o s$, $F=S.support(a,c)$ and $I=S.support(\mathrm{id}_s,c_s)$, where $c_s$ is the identity proper compactification. Equality of geometric arrows transports compactifications and support functors by equality, with identity map when the equality is reflexive. Define $\alpha:F I\simeq F$ as the inverse supplied support compositor for $(a,\mathrm{id}_s)$ followed by equality transport along $a\mathrm{id}_s=a$. For $v:I\simeq\mathrm{id}$, define the composition law to mean $\alpha_K=v_{F K}$ for every separated finite-type $X$, compactification $c$, and bounded constructible input $K$. If $I\dashv J$ has counit $e$ and $L\in B_s$, put $
u_L=v^{-1}_{J L}e_L$. Define the transport mate $c_L:G J L	o G L$ to be the conjugate of $\alpha^{-1}$ for $F I\dashv JG$ and $F\dashv G$, using the supplied exceptional adjunctions. For a predicate $P_X$ on inputs, the stage-laws proposition consists of the composition law on $P_X$, invertibility of $
u_L$ and $c_L$, $c_L=G(
u_L)$, and $F(c_L)\varepsilon_L=\varepsilon_{J L}
u_L$. For a coefficient comparison $Q:S	o S'$ over coefficient functors $T_X$, define identity compatibility by $Q_{\mathrm{id},K}v'_{T_s K}=T_s(v_K)$. At finite coefficients as in [def-sf-datum], define $v$ by the support-to-proper comparison for the identity, its direct-image realization, and the canonical direct-image identity, lifted uniquely through the fully faithful constructible inclusion. All these constructions retain the actual supplied functors and arrows.
